title: Purple Skull Shaman
description: A male character with spiky purple hair and face tattoos stands in a dynamic pose against a plain gray background. He wears a bone-adorned purple and white outfit with skull motifs, bandages, and a sash covered in symbols, while purple magical energy swirls around his raised hand.
prompt: A fierce male shaman with wild spiky purple hair, face tattoos and glowing purple eyes, wearing a vest made of white bones over purple wrappings, a long purple sash with symbols, white pants with skull knee pads, barefoot with anklets. He stands in a powerful stance casting purple magic from one hand, detailed digital character art with sharp lines and dramatic lighting on a neutral gray background.
